$description: claytxt semantic foundation roles other than colour. These values alias primitives and are the intended authoring vocabulary for generated runtime aliases. Colour roles are derived from the palette (palette.tokens.json, ADR 055).

target-coarse.$description: The least a pressable measures on each axis under a coarse pointer (Material's 48 dp touch minimum). Sizes are rem, so it is 48px only while the root font size is 16px.

rack-size.$description: The width of the navigation rack at its fullest: three targets (toggle, back, forward). A pane keeps this much of its top-left corner clear for the rack that floats over it.

layer.$description: The one z-order scale. A surface takes its layer from here; no component names a z-index of its own.
